dossier.aide:
How to find this folder
  1. In Steam, right-click Le Mans Ultimate, then Manage › Browse local files.
  2. In the window that opens, go into UserData, then into Telemetry.
  3. Click the address bar at the top of the window, copy the path (Ctrl+C) and paste it above (Ctrl+V).

The Telemetry folder only appears after your first session: if you don't have it yet, drive a few laps and come back.

groupe.partage_texte: Your online qualifying and races: your in-game driver name, tracks, cars, lap times, sectors and positions, and the telemetry of your records from those sessions (one per track and car), for your friends to compare against. Nothing else: no practice, none of your sessions against the AI, no e-mail, no PC name, no files, none of the other drivers in your sessions. Leaving the group erases your results from the service.

virages.entete: {n} corners, detected from the track curvature. “Time lost” spreads the lap gap over the corners: every metre counts for exactly one corner, so the column adds up to the final gap. Editable corner map: {fichier}

serveur.tour.incoherent: measured time {ecart} s longer than the lap time — lap not comparable (race start)
serveur.tour.quasi_arret: near stop on track ({vitesse} km/h for {duree} s)
serveur.virage.pas_de_remise_gaz: not back on the throttle before the end of the zone
serveur.avert.voitures: The two laps are not in the same car ({ref} vs {cmp}). The delta then mostly measures a difference in machinery, not in driving.
serveur.avert.arret_reference: The reference lap ({n}) nearly stopped ({vitesse} km/h for {duree} s). The delta will jump vertically at that point: the distance stops moving while the time keeps running.
serveur.avert.arret_compare: The compared lap ({n}) nearly stopped ({vitesse} km/h for {duree} s). The delta will jump vertically at that point: the distance stops moving while the time keeps running.
